raw_text: [[File:{{{Alt}}}|28px|link=]] "Summons flying bodyguards to support the Minion Prince " Contents 1 Summary 2 Strategies 2.1 Offensive Strategies 2.2 Defensive Strategies 3 Statistics 4 History 5 Trivia Summary The Henchmen Puppet is a piece of Common Hero Equipment for the Minion Prince . It is one of two pieces of Hero Equipment that is unlocked alongside him, the other being the Dark Orb . The Henchmen Puppet appears as a light blue keychain with black eyes, horns, and a spiked collar at the end, held by chains connecting to a chibi-styled head of the Henchman. When equipped, it enables the Minion Prince to summon two Henchmen when using his ability. Additionally, upon activation, he turns invisible for a short duration, which, among other things, allows these Henchmen to tank for him, all while distracting defenses from targeting him. In addition to the ability, the Henchmen Puppet grants additional damage and hitpoints to the Minion Prince, and also increases the amount of health he recovers when using the ability. Strategies Offensive Strategies The Henchmen Puppet can be used to let the Henchmen tank Seeking Air Mines for the Minion Prince. It can also be used to stop defenses from targeting him, such as single-target Inferno Towers, as this ability turns him invisible for one second. It can be paired with Dark Orb , slowing down defenses in a large area and increasing the effectiveness of the tanking by the Henchmen. Defensive Strategies To prevent wasting Seeking Air Mines to take out the Henchmen, it is advised to spread your Seeking Mines away from each other, maximizing their effectiveness, so that they will be able to take out the Minion Prince or other important aerial units like Super Dragons. Trivia The Henchmen Puppet is one of the equipment that spawn additional troops when activated, the others being Barbarian Puppet , Archer Puppet , Healer Puppet , Action Figure , Lavaloon Puppet , and Hog Rider Puppet . Despite having "Puppet" in its name, it does not resemble a voodoo doll, instead it resembles a keychain.
